labelBasis: Manual source-derived targets from canonical MSSR authorities; not independently adjudicated and not a holdout.

requiredClaims: Contradiction/unresolved/non-comparable evidence remains separate or review-only.
Supersession is represented as a temporal relation, not silent overwrite.
The raw 0.75 gate is exploratory and uncalibrated; no canonical write is authorized.
Jev labels/selects among explicit candidates but does not establish authority, truth, permission, verification, or canonical write rights.
Contradictory, unresolved, non-comparable, non-fresh, or unverified evidence cannot become a consolidation preview.
The host rereads source revisions before consuming a preview; permission and independent verification remain outside Jev.
